name: Content Moderation Bulk State Change
description: Adds a 'Change workflow stage' bulk action that moves several selected nodes to one content-moderation state at once via a confirm form, on top of core Content Moderation and Workflows.
project_description:
This module leverages Drupal bulk actions to streamline content workflows. Whether transitioning drafts to published status or archiving outdated content, this tool enhances efficiency for content managers and site administrators.

 Features 
 Allows content editors to select multiple pieces of content via the content listing, and apply transitions to the entities in bulk.

 Post-Installation 
 After installation, a bulk action is enabled on content views.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires content moderation.

 Supporting this Module 
 Add issues to the issue queue.
